scope: Normal application menu, worker simulation, production circuit renderer and archived replay. 1280x800 viewport. Clear uses the Low preset; rain uses Low with particle density 1 selected through the normal settings UI. No simulation frames or renderer poses are injected. These software-GPU checks do not measure physical-device frame rates.
